text: I just watched a very beautiful show. Very magical and very impressive. It's a story about loss of love. The main character is in love at the very beginning, then suddenly loses it and then a twist in the story, that I didn't see coming. The light, the water symbol, the music, the design, the whole thing is beautifully done and there are some absolutely jaw-dropping moments. The actors, the dancers, the synchronized swimmers, the acrobats. All very synchronized and very precise. The flips and the dives and the synchronized swimming, where they hold their breath for very, very long. And yet, it's very emotional, but it's very funny, too. I enjoyed it so much, that I'm very inspired by this. This whole thing is very imaginative and very huge and very moving. So go see it. Must see.
